exampleCoverLetter.name: Alex Rivera
exampleCoverLetter.heading: Application for Research Program Coordinator
paragraphs: I am applying for the Research Program Coordinator position because I enjoy turning research ideas into fundable, well-run programs. I hold a PhD in Environmental Science from Springfield University, and the Institute's focus on shared research infrastructure is exactly where I want to apply that experience.

In 2024 I drafted the project plan, budget narrative and partner letters for a foundation grant that funds a three-year water-quality program, with my department chair as the formal applicant. I also wrote the successful proposal for my graduate fellowship.

Your posting emphasizes coordination across sites. I agree sampling schedules and methods with four partner municipalities and report results to their councils every quarter. I also organized an eight-talk public speaker series for a regional society, from speakers to venues.

I build tools that help researchers use data. My water-quality dashboard has about 40 weekly users, and I would bring the same practical approach to the Institute's program reporting. I have not managed a program budget yet, and I would value learning the Institute's processes.
I would welcome the chance to discuss how my grant-writing and coordination experience could support your programs. Thank you for considering my application.
